{{ $('Extract New Sender Intent').first().json.wantsHelp ? 'Here is everything we can do for you.' : 'We could not tell what you would like us to do, so here is everything we can do for you.' }}

You are not a customer with us yet. Opening an account takes one email -- just reply with your date of birth, and which account you want:

    I would like to open a checking account.
    Date of birth: 1998-04-22

We accept 1998-04-22, 22/04/1998 or 22 April 1998. If you are under 18, include a parent or guardian's email address and we will ask them to approve it. There is no minimum deposit and no paperwork.

Once your account is open, everything below works by email too.

WHAT YOU CAN ASK US TO DO

Check your balance        "What is my balance?"
Get a statement           "Send me my statement for last month"

- We will never ask you for a password, PIN, card number or one-time code.
- Email is our only channel. There is no app, branch or phone line.
- Reply to any message from us and a person will read it.

Digital Bank

options.systemMessage:
You are an intent classifier for a bank's email system. Read the email body (authoritative) and subject below, then respond with EXACTLY ONE WORD: one of JOINT_OPEN, OPEN_ACCOUNT, ACCOUNT_CLOSURE, STATEMENT, DISPUTE, LOAN_APPLICATION, LOAN_CANCEL, DEPOSIT, STANDING_ORDER, TRANSFER, BALANCE, POLICY_RAG, UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS, UNKNOWN.

Key distinctions:
- OPEN_ACCOUNT: any wording for wanting a new personal account (create, open, start, set up, sign up, register, become a customer).
- JOINT_OPEN: wanting to open a shared/joint account with someone else.
- ACCOUNT_CLOSURE: wanting an existing account closed, deleted, cancelled, deactivated or terminated. If they are ASKING what the closure rules are rather than requesting it, that is POLICY_RAG. If they want their money moved somewhere first, that is TRANSFER.
- STATEMENT: wanting a statement, transaction history, or a list of past activity on their account. BALANCE is just the current number; STATEMENT is the history.
- DISPUTE: the sender's OWN transaction, card, or account was used fraudulently/without their permission -- they want it investigated or frozen. Trigger words: unauthorized transaction, fraud, stolen, didn't make this charge, someone used my card, I do not recognise this payment.
- UNAUTHORIZED_ACCESS: the sender is asking for details (balance, transactions) about an account that belongs to someone ELSE, not their own.
- LOAN_APPLICATION: wants to borrow money. LOAN_CANCEL: wants an existing loan APPLICATION cancelled, withdrawn or revoked before it is decided -- this is about taking back a request, not about asking for one. DEPOSIT: wants to add/deposit money into their own account. STANDING_ORDER: a recurring/scheduled payment. TRANSFER: wants to send money to someone. BALANCE: wants their own current balance. POLICY_RAG: asking about fees, limits, rules, policies. UNKNOWN: genuinely none of the above (e.g. spam, small talk, an unrelated topic).

Do not explain. Do not add punctuation. Output only the single label word.

This email is from someone who is NOT yet a bank customer. Read the body (authoritative) and subject, then respond with EXACTLY ONE WORD: OPEN_ACCOUNT, POLICY, or OTHER.

OPEN_ACCOUNT: any wording for wanting to open/create/start/set up a personal bank account, sign up, register, or become a customer.
POLICY: asking a question about the bank's fees, limits, rules, policies, hours, or services -- they do not need an account to ask this.
OTHER: anything else (spam, small talk, unrelated topic, or a request like a transfer/balance check that a non-customer cannot do).

Do not explain. Do not add punctuation. Output only the single word.

nodes.name: Ignore Automated Sender
nodes.notes: Dead end on purpose. An automated notification (a Google security alert, a bounce, a mailing-list digest) is not a customer request. Replying to one is at best noise sent to a mailbox nobody reads, and at worst a mail loop with another robot. Nothing is sent and no case is opened.

parameters.subject: =About your question to Digital Bank
parameters.message:
=Hello,

We promised you a follow-up on the question you sent us, so we want to close the loop rather than leave you waiting.

Our specialist has reviewed it and we are not able to give you a confirmed answer by email on this one. Rather than send you something we can't stand behind, we would rather tell you straight.

{{ $json.decision_note ? 'Note from our team: ' + $json.decision_note + '\n\n' : '' }}Please reply to this email with any more detail you can give us, and we will take another look. If it is urgent, say so in your reply and we will prioritise it.

Apologies for not having a fuller answer for you this time.

Digital Bank Customer Support

parameters.subject: =RE: {{ $json.subject }} - about closing your account
=RE: {{ $('Resolve Account Closure Request').item.json.subject }} - we can't close that account yet
=[{{ $json.ref_code }}] Confirm closing account {{ $json.account_number }}
parameters.message:
=Hello,

{{ $json.isRequester ? 'You asked us to close account ' + $json.account_number + '.' : $json.requester_email + ' has asked us to close account ' + $json.account_number + ', which you hold with them.' }}

Account: {{ $json.account_number }} ({{ $json.account_type }})
Balance: Rs 0.00

Closing an account is permanent. We cannot reopen it afterwards, and the account number is not reissued. So we will not act on the request until it is confirmed.

{{ $json.isSoleHolder ? 'HOW TO CONFIRM' : 'HOW TO ANSWER - all ' + $json.holder_count + ' holders must agree before the account closes' }}
Reply to this email with a single word on the first line:

    APPROVE
or
    REJECT

Keep the reference {{ $json.ref_code }} in the reply - it is already in the subject line, so a normal reply works. Your reply must contain APPROVE or REJECT but not both.

{{ $json.isSoleHolder ? 'REJECT, or simply ignoring this email, leaves your account open and unchanged.' : 'A single REJECT from any holder stops the closure and the account stays open.' }} If nobody confirms by {{ $json.expires_at }} the request expires on its own and the account stays open.

If you did not expect this email, reply REJECT.

Digital Bank Customer Support

parameters.subject: =Thank you - your input on dispute {{ $json.ref_code }} is recorded
parameters.message:
=Hello,

We have recorded your response to dispute {{ $json.ref_code }}.

You said you {{ $json.agrees ? 'AGREE' : 'DO NOT AGREE' }} with the dispute raised by {{ $json.raised_by_email }}.

We now have {{ $json.inputs_received }} of {{ $json.holders_total }} holders' input on this.

A specialist reviews every dispute personally, and they will see what each of you said before deciding. Neither your agreement nor your disagreement decides it on its own - that is deliberate, because a dispute between joint holders is exactly the kind of thing a person should look at rather than a rule.

We will email you when there is a decision.

Digital Bank Disputes Team

To respond, reply to the original email with the single word APPROVE (if you agree the transaction was not authorised) or REJECT (if you think it was legitimate), keeping the reference code in the message. You can add a line starting with NOTE: to tell us anything else.

Digital Bank Disputes Team

parameters.subject: =RE: {{ $json.subject }} - which account?
=[{{ $('Raise Dispute').item.json.ops_ref_code }}] Dispute {{ $('Raise Dispute').item.json.ref_code }} on {{ $('Raise Dispute').item.json.account_number }}
=[{{ $json.ref_code }}] {{ $json.raised_by_email }} has disputed activity on your joint account
parameters.message:
=Hello,

{{ $json.raised_by_email }}, who holds account {{ $json.account_number }} with you, has raised a dispute and we would like your side before a specialist decides.

Account: {{ $json.account_number }}
{{ $json.amountFormatted ? 'Amount disputed: ' + $json.amountFormatted : 'They did not identify a specific transaction.' }}

WHAT THEY TOLD US
{{ $json.description }}

WHY WE ARE ASKING YOU
On a joint account, either of you can raise a dispute on your own - we do not make someone wait for permission to report suspected fraud. But we do not decide it on one person's word either, so we ask everyone who holds the account.

If this was a transaction you made and authorised, say so - that is exactly the kind of thing we need to know.

HOW TO ANSWER
Reply to this email with a single word on the first line:

    APPROVE   - you agree this was not authorised
or
    REJECT    - you believe it was legitimate

Add a line starting with NOTE: to explain anything. Keep the reference {{ $json.ref_code }} in the reply - it is already in the subject line.

Neither answer decides it by itself. A specialist reads everything and makes the call.

Digital Bank Disputes Team

parameters.subject: =RE: {{ $('Resolve Dispute Request').item.json.subject }} - about your dispute
parameters.message:

Reason: {{ $json.error }}

This does not mean we are ignoring you. Reply to this email with as much detail as you can - the amount, roughly when it happened, and the account number - and a specialist will pick it up directly.

If you believe your account is at immediate risk, say so in your reply and we will prioritise it.

Digital Bank Disputes Team

They hold no customer account here, which is required -- an operator can act on any account.

IF YOU APPROVE, they will be able to:

Reply to this email with a single word on the first line:

    APPROVE
or
    REJECT

Keep the reference {{ $json.refCode }} in the reply -- it is already in the subject line. It expires in 7 days.

If you did not expect this, REJECT and change the phrase:

parameters.subject: =Digital Bank - you are now on the operations team
parameters.message:
=The administrator has approved your request. Your address is now a Digital Bank operator.

WHAT YOU CAN DO, by emailing this address:

  Decide a loan application awaiting review:
    reject loan for ACC-1234567890
    NOTE: insufficient account history

  Change the pass phrase:
    NEW PASSPHRASE: something only the team knows

  Answer any request carrying an OPS- reference code, by replying to it with
  the single word APPROVE or REJECT.

WHAT YOU CANNOT DO:

  Credit an account. That creates money out of the bank's treasury and is
  reserved to the administrator.

  Hold a customer account at this bank while you are an operator.

Every action you take is recorded in the audit log against your address.

Digital Bank Operations
